notes: «- واللفظ له -» is an editor gloss and is left out; «قال عبد أخبرنا» and «وقال ابن رافع» are the same two co-transmitters, not new links
the second isnad after the first saying starts at «قال الزهري وحدثني حميد»; its route before Zuhri is not written again, so the group starts at Zuhri
the Prophet is not a link; «قال الزهري ذلك لئلا يتكل» is Zuhri's comment
